evidence_kind: read-only PE bytes and x86 Capstone disassembly; not REA provider Evidence, not runtime observation

ani.warning: Do not use local dispatch enum as PVF compiled token ID; this package is text ANI.

contact.position_return_type: signed integer converted to float32 before addition
contact.iteration: ordered A current attack boxes outer; B current damage boxes inner; first accepted pair returns true
contact.child_ani: 0x4AEF80 first primary ANI pair, then A primary ANI child list+0x180, node ANI+0x0C against B current ANI; first success returns true
contact.gate_semantics: enable predicates only; formal state names unknown; do not label invulnerability or super armor

intersection.early_reject: for all six extents: abs(extent)*2^-23 >= abs(extent) => false
intersection.finite_domain_effect: zero extent rejects; nonzero finite negative extent does not reject at this stage
intersection.separation: for each axis reject if B.min > f32(A.min+A.extent) OR A.min > f32(B.min+B.extent)
intersection.float_rounding: source slots are float32; max endpoint additions are stored to float32 before comparisons; output subtraction is stored to float32; standard nearest-even is a reconstruction assumption until native x87 control word is verified
unsupported_native_corner_cases: x87 control word modes different from default

preview_safe_domain.policy: reject invalid source geometry while retaining raw source values and warning; this validation is preview policy, not a claimed native negative/NaN rule
